monk_ac_bonus.name: Monk AC Bonus
monk_ac_bonus.description: When unarmored and unencumbered, add Wisdom bonus (if positive) + 1 per 5 monk levels to AC (applies even against touch attacks or when flat-footed).

flurry_of_blows.name: Flurry of Blows
flurry_of_blows.description: Strike with a flurry of blows at the expense of accuracy (-2/-2 at 1st, -1/-1 at 5th, +0/+0 at 9th, two extra attacks at 11th).

unarmed_strike.name: Unarmed Strike
unarmed_strike.description: Gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat; unarmed damage scales from 1d6 at 1st to 2d10 at 20th level.

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.description: Take no damage instead of half damage on a successful Reflex saving throw.

still_mind.name: Still Mind
still_mind.description: +2 bonus on saving throws against spells and effects from the school of enchantment.

wholeness_of_body.name: Wholeness of Body
wholeness_of_body.description: Heal your own wounds up to twice your current monk level in hit points each day.

diamond_soul.name: Diamond Soul
diamond_soul.description: Gain Spell Resistance equal to current monk level + 10.

quivering_palm.name: Quivering Palm
quivering_palm.description: Set up fatal vibrations within the body of another creature 1/week (Fortitude save DC 10 + 1/2 monk level + WIS mod or die).

perfect_self.name: Perfect Self
perfect_self.description: Become a magical creature (Outsider [native]) and gain Damage Reduction 10/magic.

acfSwaps.name: Decisive Strike
acfSwaps.description: Replaces Flurry of Blows: make one unarmed or special monk weapon attack as a full-round action at -2 that deals double damage (including any AoOs before your next turn).

acfSwaps.name: Invisible Fist
acfSwaps.description: Replaces Evasion: turn invisible for 1 round as an immediate action every 3 rounds.
